verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS accounting product like Mercury Books, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics opt-out, usage-tracking controls or privacy settings. The cited material covers accounting features, integrations, Command AI, pricing and future API/MCP plans, none of which touch tracking controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
